items.t: Takata passenger airbag inflator can rupture (do-not-drive recall)
items.job: Recall repair at a Lincoln dealer
items.note: Free at a Lincoln dealer under the recall. Check your VIN first.

items.t: Driver airbag inflator can explode (recall)
items.job: Recall repair at a Lincoln dealer
items.note: Free at a Lincoln dealer under the recall. Check your VIN first.

items.t: Coolant leaking into the cylinders
items.job: Replace engine long block
items.note: CarComplaints owners report about $8,400 on average. Ask a dealer about goodwill help.

items.t: Internal water pump leaks coolant into the oil
items.job: Replace internal water pump (timing chain removal)
items.note: Many shops replace the timing chain at the same time. One CarComplaints owner paid about $4,000. If coolant got into the oil, the engine may need more work.

items.t: Harsh or delayed automatic shifts
items.job: Transmission diagnosis, fluid service and solenoid body replacement
items.note: CarComplaints owners report about $2,000. A full rebuild costs more.

items.t: Key gets stuck in the ignition
items.job: Replace ignition lock cylinder

items.t: Chrome peeling off the wheels
items.job: Replace or refinish one wheel
items.note: Price is per wheel. CarComplaints owners report about $1,200 for a set.

items.t: Dashboard bubbling near the vents
items.job: Replace dashboard top pad
items.note: CarComplaints owners report about $2,400. A molded dash cover costs far less.

items.t: Brake lights or tail lights stop working
items.job: Replace tail lamp assembly (one side)
items.note: CarComplaints owners report about $400 to $1,200.

items.t: Tires wear out early
items.job: Four-wheel alignment
items.note: New tires add several hundred dollars; CarComplaints owners report about $1,200 total.

items.t: Engine stalls while driving
items.job: Diagnose stalling and update engine software
items.note: CarComplaints owners report about $400.

items.t: Rattle from a cracked flexplate
items.job: Replace flexplate
items.note: Ford program 22N12 may cover this for some owners.

items.t: Cooling fans stop from blown fuses
items.job: Replace cooling fan fuses and test fan motor
items.note: If the fan motor itself is bad, parts cost more.

items.t: Hybrid transmission thumping or grinding
items.job: Disassemble and clean or repair hybrid transmission
items.note: Replacing the whole hybrid transmission costs several thousand dollars more.

items.t: SYNC 3 screen freezes or lags
items.job: SYNC software update or reset
items.note: If a module must be replaced, parts cost several hundred dollars.

items.t: Backup camera blank or stays on (recall)
